name: remote-android
description: 云端安卓模拟器多开管理平台(redroid + scrcpy + WebCodecs)

scripts.install:all: npm run install:server && npm run install:web
scripts.dev: concurrently -c cyan,magenta --kill-others --kill-others-on-fail --prefix "[{name}]" --names "SERVER,WEB" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: cd web && npm run build && cd ../server && npm run build
